name: fac-session-agreements
description: Drafts a one-page set of working agreements for the room to edit, the confidentiality rule in plain words, and consent wording for any recording, transcription or AI note-taking, with what happens if one person declines. Use for "run fac-session-agreements", "ground rules for a workshop", "working agreements for my session", "consent wording for recording a training", "an AI note-taker joined my session", "what do I say about confidentiality", "someone does not want to be recorded", "Chatham House Rule wording", part of the Claude for Trainers and Facilitators Pack by 90n.
